versions.changelog:
Initial release of PlanWright Control Plane.

- Provides a shared control system for coordinating multiple autonomous coding agents and maintaining an auditable ledger of their work.
- Supports managing objectives, agent session claims, and progress tracking through a standardized workflow.
- Includes tools for objective management, agent workflow execution, audit recording, and bug tracking.
- Clearly documents common gotchas (e.g., anchoring to the repo) and step-by-step usage guidance.
- Enables users to maintain a verifiable audit trail for all agent actions and project changes.
